summary: AISDLC-725 PR #1346 over the 2-round review cap: resume with one extra round, split the security fix, withdraw and re-scope, or park

options.description: rebase onto main, authorise a 3rd reviewer round on the committed DEC-0219 fix (ledger via git show, review paths blocked for developer writes), sign, flip; AC6 ten-round report becomes a follow-up task
land only the committed-ledger + blocked-paths fix as a small PR; park the rest
supersede the PR, split 725 into three tasks, run fresh

body: PR #1346 (+3129/-175, 40 files, CLEAN, no red checks) exceeded DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS=2 with a security MAJOR (developer could edit unsigned review-state/ledger to force a delta-only round). Round 3 (DEC-0219) committed the fix: prior findings read from the committed ledger via git show; .ai-sdlc/reviews/** and review-state/** blocked for developer writes (folds in 725.1). Unconfirmed by reviewers, no attestation. Test timeouts were in files the PR does not touch; #1585/#1590 made those tests hermetic. Rubric: closed PRs are wasted work, the diff already had two reviewer rounds, round 3 is delta-only on the committed fix; the cap's human look is this decision.
